profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack Staff Software Engineer who builds scalable products and the architecture behind them. With a strong foundation in end-user product engineering alongside suite-wide platform and security experience, I bridge product velocity with technical depth. I specialize in turning complex problems from core product features to identity systems and shared infrastructure into clean, resilient systems that move business metrics.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led cross-functional platform and security initiatives, modernizing core infrastructure, driving observability standards, and scaling shared services.

AuthN/AuthZ & MFA Modernization: Architected and executed a comprehensive identity overhaul across the product suite. Authored architectural RFCs, navigated complex technical tradeoffs, and aligned cross-product engineering teams to deliver seamless, multi-factor authentication (MFA).

Centralized Transactional Email Service: Designed and implemented a shared transactional email service with real-time Snowflake analytics integration to monitor deliverability metrics and preserve domain reputation.

Observability & Incident Response: Accelerated organization-wide Datadog adoption and established engineering rituals for active error triage, drastically reducing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · React.js · Claude Code · Argo CD · FastAPI · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog · Next.js

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Lead Engineer and Manager for a team of 3.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · graphiti · FastAPI · Data Analysis · Neo4j · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product: Text Engagement
Description: Connect with candidates anywhere - at scale - with AI-powered conversational text messages.
Features:
- Apply to jobs via text channels, increasing top of funnel applications by up to 10% for certain customers
- Improved accuracy of customer usage metrics, lowering ticket volume
- Improved the observability of our stack, resulting in an average .15% increase in our uptime
Responsibilities:
- Lead developer, coordinating tasks across teams and driving for results.
- Creating structured API documentation (OpenAPI) for customers
- Consulting with customers to get product feedback, and develop new features or improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · New Relic

positions.title: Software Engineer - Product
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead developer for the Direct Deposit team. Wore many hats, including DBA, developer, architect, data analyst, backend and frontend developer.

- Coordinated development across multiple teams (integrations, hub) and roles (product, engineering)
- Designed virtual bank account solution for cryptocurrency customers
- Implemented end-user survey (React.js) for collecting funnel metric feedback
- Monitored conversion metrics (Statsig), performed A/B testing, and implemented improvements
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · React.js · FastAPI · Datadog

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Product: GitOps
Description: Declarative, version controlled application definitions, configurations, and environments. Make application deployment and lifecycle management automated, auditable, and easy to understand.

- Embedded the Argo CD runtime inside the GitOps Agent
- Used the MongoDB oplog for Server Side Events (SSE)
- Designed the protocol between the GitOps Agent and Service (bi-directional gRPC)
- Created k8s YAML for the initial GitOps Agent installation
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Argo CD · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · gRPC · MongoDB

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Holmdel, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description: Refreshed the Career Sites product and introduced universal login.  Worked through a merger with another company’s competing career site product.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Java · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: Middletown, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Worked on several projects, including:

Provisioning Automation Layer (PAL) - automated provisioning of customer edge routers.
AT&T website - eCommerce platform for selling mobile phone plans.
Global Fault Platform (GFP) - collect and correlate SNMP trap data and trigger alarms.
